decision: What concept should the savargupta.com share card (Open Graph image) use?
invariants: real desk assets only, no AI image of Savar

options.bet: Show a crop of the real desk
options.cost: Busy; objects are small at chat size
options.risk: Reads as a cluttered white card in white feeds

options.bet: One brand colour and the sugar-cube icon, huge
options.benefit: Best legibility at thumbnail size; ties to the favicon
options.cost: Says less about what is on the site
options.risk: Flat graphic can feel like a startup ad

options.bet: The RAZR rings: a hook that asks to be tapped
options.benefit: Stands out on dark and light feeds; ties to the ringing phone on the desk
options.cost: Name is in a sentence, not a headline
options.risk: Some will read it as a prank or spam call

options.bet: Scrapbook of real photos around a name label
options.risk: Detail turns to noise at 300 px
